mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, conditions are clear at Badger Ridge Middle School, and the moon is currently in a Waxing Gibbous phase.
The Department of Public Works is currently recruiting an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal and utility construction projects, with applications due by 11:59 PM this Sunday.

We have a busy weekend ahead with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today, along with the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Tomorrow, you can catch a yoga class at Insight Wellness.
During the week of August 10 through August 17, there was a notable incident on Friday, August 15, where a 29-year-old Verona man was arrested for a second offence O W I after a traffic stop.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is Devil's Food Cake, and the store is open until 11:00 PM tonight. You can also catch Kona Ice today at Fireman's Park until 5 PM and at the Verona Youth Football stadium until 7:30 PM.
